title: 3 numbers to put on every anodizing spec
audience: Procurement managers and design engineers specifying architectural aluminum (LinkedIn)

scenes.text: Specifying anodized aluminum? Three numbers decide whether your parts pass inspection.
One. Coating thickness. Class one architectural work needs at least 18 microns.
Two. Seal quality. Ask for an acid dissolution test result on every lot.
Three. Color match. Hold every batch to a Delta E of 1.5 or less against your approved sample.
